name: Antu
description: Draw legal diagrams from JSON as one offline HTML file.
description_zh: 用结构化 JSON 画法律图：事实时间线、程序流程图、主体关系图、裁判说理证成图，生成可离线打开的单个 HTML 文件。
description_en: Legal diagrams from JSON: case timelines, procedures, party relationships and court reasoning, as one offline HTML file.
examples_zh: 把这个案件的经过画成事实时间线
画出这几家公司之间的股权和担保关系
把这份合同的履行流程画成流程图
把这份判决书的说理画成证成图
examples_en: Draw the course of this case as a fact timeline
Draw the shareholding and guarantee ties between these companies
Turn this contract's performance steps into a flowchart
Draw how this judgment reasoned from facts to its conclusion
